heard: An asteroid sample was so huge it jammed its own lid. On October 20, 2020, the OSIRIS-Rx probe touched down on asteroid Bennu to collect regolith. Upon contact, a burst of nitrogen gas stirred up surface material into the sampler head. The probe collected so much material that rocks jammed the sampler head's mylar flap open. Valuable asteroid dust began escaping and drifting away into the vacuum of space. Mission controllers canceled a spinning maneuver to weigh the sample and expedited stowing. Despite the chaotic leak, the capsule brought home a record 121.6 grams of material. An asteroid sample was so huge, it almost caused a total loss.
